tourismTax.label: Tourism taxes collected and remitted on behalf of hosts
tourismTax.definition: Tourism taxes collected and remitted on behalf of U.S. hosts in 2025, by state (all 50 states and Washington, DC), from Airbnb's state map (column '2025 TOTAL (in USD)', published in millions to one decimal, e.g. '$45.5M'). Airbnb says U.S. stays generated 'approximately $2.7 billion in these taxes' in 2025; the state values sum to $2,710.6 million.

jobsSupported.label: Estimated jobs supported (Airbnb IMPLAN analysis)
jobsSupported.definition: Jobs supported by visitor spending on Airbnb, from Airbnb's internal analysis using the IMPLAN economic impact model: Canada ('more than 100,000 estimated jobs nationwide in 2025') and Vietnam ('supported more than 85,000 jobs' in 2025). Estimate; not the Oxford Economics study.

jobsSupportedOE.label: Jobs supported (Oxford Economics study)
jobsSupportedOE.definition: Jobs supported by the economic activity Airbnb generates, from the Oxford Economics study Airbnb commissioned for 10 Asia-Pacific countries ('Airbnb commissioned Oxford Economics ... to assess the impact of Airbnb’s ecosystem on communities throughout Asia Pacific').

impactGdp.label: Estimated total contribution to GDP from travel on Airbnb
impactGdp.definition: Airbnb's own estimate: "Estimated economic impact based on an internal analysis using the IMPLAN economic impact model". State map column 'Total GDP', published in dollars and stored here in millions. An estimate, not a reported transaction. The state values sum to about $91.9 billion, below the release's 'more than $93 billion in economic activity' headline.

impactJobs.label: Estimated jobs supported (Airbnb IMPLAN analysis)
impactJobs.definition: Jobs supported by Airbnb guest and host activity, from Airbnb's internal IMPLAN-model analysis (U.S. state map column 'Jobs Supported', published as exact counts). Estimate. The state values sum to about 1.07 million; the release's national headline is 'more than 1.1 million estimated jobs'.

impactTax.label: Estimated total tax generated
impactTax.definition: Total tax revenue associated with economic activity generated by Airbnb stays (state map column 'Total Tax Revenue', published in dollars and stored here in millions), from the same internal IMPLAN analysis. The state values sum to about $23.8 billion; the release's national headline is 'over $26 billion in total tax revenue'. Broader than, and not comparable to, tourismTax.

notes: usStates: two rows per state (50 states and DC), both from Airbnb-authored Flourish maps embedded in Airbnb newsroom posts; the rows sit in each chart's data <script> block. (1) The 2025 U.S. economic impact map (news.airbnb.com/hosts-and-guests-boost-us-economy-by-a-record-93b-in-2025, Apr 15, 2026): jobs supported, GDP and total tax revenue by state, internal IMPLAN estimates, replacing the 2024 map. (2) The 2025 tourism-tax map (news.airbnb.com/hosts-and-guests-generated-17-3b-in-tourism-taxes-for-communities-around-the-world, Apr 6, 2026): taxes Airbnb collected and remitted on behalf of hosts, now for every state, replacing the 2024 newsroom list of 19 states and DC. State sums fall short of the national headlines (jobs about 1.07 million vs 'more than 1.1 million'; GDP about $91.9 billion vs 'more than $93 billion in economic activity'; tax about $23.8 billion vs 'over $26 billion'); tourism taxes sum to $2,710.6 million vs 'approximately $2.7 billion'. Countries: jobs supported in 9 Asia-Pacific countries from Airbnb's Oxford Economics-commissioned 2024 study (company-commissioned); the country pages were re-read on 2026-11-24 and still report 2024, so no newer edition was found. Thailand is 'Nearly 110,000', recorded as 110,000. Vietnam's page is not part of that study: it reports 2025 from Airbnb's internal IMPLAN analysis ('supported more than 85,000 jobs'), and is now added under the same internal-analysis metric as Canada. Canada's 'more than 100,000 estimated jobs nationwide in 2025' (plus) is from Airbnb's internal IMPLAN analysis in its 2025 Canada release (company-published), replacing the 2024 release's 'over 105,000'. Local-currency GDP figures per country were not recorded, to avoid mixing currencies. 10-K Item 2 names only the San Francisco headquarters.
